exposure: GDM subtypes based on OGTT results (isolated fasting hyperglycemia, isolated post-load hyperglycemia, combined hyperglycemia)
abnormal glucose concentrations at various oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) time points
cohort: The study included 257 pregnant women diagnosed with GDM (IADPSG criteria) who delivered at a tertiary hospital between 2020 and 2023.
finding: While GDM subtypes identified by OGTT were associated with distinct metabolic phenotypes (e.g., BMI, insulin use) and showed univariate differences in some perinatal outcomes, multivariable analyses did not find significant differences in adverse perinatal outcomes among these GDM subtypes.
